_comment: VELO Notebook Mono — single source of truth for every visual value. Consume via CSS variables in website/index.html — never hardcode.

ink-soft._role: ALL text + ALL borders on light surfaces

yellow._role: PRIMARY tint — marquee, highlight blocks, kicker, hovers

yellow-deep._role: SECONDARY accent — CTA fills, live badge, quote card, signals

h1.value: clamp(1.9rem, 5vw, 3.4rem)/1.18 Space Mono 400 UPPERCASE (keywords 700 on #FFF9A3 block)

radius.value: 0 — anti-slop contract: square everything, no exceptions

borders.value: 2px solid #3A3A3A for cards/buttons/bands; 1px rgba(255,255,255,.28) on dark; shadows FORBIDDEN

layout.value: max 1200px, 24px gutters, full-bleed color bands: cream -> pastel -> cream -> pastel -> black -> cream -> white
